nodes.label: Open Graph Social Sharing Image
nodes.description: OG/social-sharing image for OrderMatrix. Off-white cream background with subtle grid pattern. Top-left: circular logo containing a 3×3 dot grid with a single orange-red accent dot at top-right of the grid. Beside it the brand name 'ordermatrix' in bold black sans-serif. Below: headline 'Manage orders, payments & dispatch — all in one place.' where 'all in one place.' is rendered in orange-red. Bottom-left footer reads 'HAR ORDER KA LOGIC · ORDERMATRIX.IN' in small spaced caps. Color palette: off-white/cream (#F5F0EB approx), near-black, orange-red accent (~#E85227). Conveys an all-in-one order management platform brand identity.

nodes.label: OrderMatrix Brand
nodes.description: Brand identity for OrderMatrix — an order-management platform. Tagline: 'Manage orders, payments & dispatch — all in one place.' Slogan: 'Har Order Ka Logic'. Domain: ordermatrix.in. Visual identity uses a circle-with-dot-grid logo and an orange-red accent color.
